visualCharacteristics: Two large entry-point cards side by side, each with imagery, a heading, supporting text, and a prominent call-to-action.
contentPattern: One row per card; an image cell plus a body cell with heading, description, and a CTA link.
usage: Presents a small number of major choices/entry points (e.g. 'Build with AI' vs 'Browse templates') as large actionable cards.
